Tests for {@link Symmetry454Chronology} and {@link Symmetry454Date}.

The Symmetry454 calendar arranges its 12 months into 4 quarters of 91 days each. Within each quarter the months follow a 4-5-4 week pattern:

  • Short months (4 weeks = 28 days): months 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 9, 10, and 12 in normal years
  • Long months (5 weeks = 35 days): months 2, 5, 8, 11, and month 12 in leap years
Normal years contain 364 days (52 weeks); leap years add a 53rd "leap week" at the end of December, extending December to 35 days and the year to 371 days. The epoch (day 0) aligns with the ISO epoch: 0001-01-01 in both calendars is the same day.
